summary: Use one continuous Nex progress panel rather than alternating waiting and stock progress layouts. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Operators see a fixed progress layout with actual per-step information.

api.reason: Local frontend presentation preserves backend operations and changes no Controller/Core or client-facing API.

state.reason: Installer presentation and input handling only; the installed host gains no new durable setting and the Controller stores nothing.

verification.method: Native framebuffer regression compares active, gap and resumed layouts, then exercises errors, logs and completion. See QA for actual results and limits.
